clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix sends trained gophers after blueleaf tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

Mebok Mizzyrix has trained snufflenose gophers to find blueleaf tubers deep in Razorfen Kraul. The roots lie hidden beneath the thorny tunnels, where finding them is nearly impossible without help. Mebok, a merchant in Ratchet, avoids entering the quilboar dens himself. He gives adventurers the Snufflenose Command Stick to direct the gophers. From up to fifty paces away, the stick guides them to sniff out and uncover the roots.
